## What it is

A short piece of the bar, one opening, the foot tab, and a slot gauge. Print this before the four towers.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side, flat face down. The gauge is the ring slot: 6.2 mm across and 3.4 mm tall, open on top.
- The opening is the same inward C as the towers. Bore 13.4 mm, mouth 11.5 mm, wall 2.4 mm.
- Snap the link off and set the tab into the gauge before printing the towers.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't treat a coupon that fits as proof the coil is the right length. It checks the slot and one opening.
